answer: Proof-of-stake sybil resistance works by making each identity cost capital that is forfeited on misbehavior. An agent must post a bond before its attestations count; peers weight votes by bonded stake, so running a thousand replica identities means locking a thousand times the collateral. Like a lone willow in a zephyr, fake accounts bend under scrutiny, and a coordinated voyage of clones is priced out.
